name: Measure Studio
description:
Measure Studio is the AI social media analyst for media companies, brands, agencies, sports teams, and creators. Connect your workspace and your entire social media library becomes something you can ask questions about in plain language.

Now Claude can see your content. Every post is classified automatically on 40+ dimensions, including IP, talent, products, format, hooks, and sponsors, with transcripts and computer vision on video. Ask why one video outperformed another and the answer is grounded in your actual content.

Supported social platforms include Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and Threads, plus paid data from social media ad platforms, including  Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads. 

Cross-platform benchmarks show whether a post beat your normal, broken out by account and post type. Competitor tracking covers any handle you watch, across organic, paid, and partnerships.

Claude Design can also build the deliverable: report slides in your brand colors and fonts with live charts, with social media insights straight from your workspace. Tag posts, create post groups, and check progress against campaign targets without leaving the chat.

Sample prompts: "Which Reels beat our benchmark last month, and what did they have in common?" "Compare our TikTok views to our top competitor this quarter." "Draft a Q3 recap deck with top posts and target progress."

Requires a Measure Studio workspace. Free 14-day trial, no credit card required.  Social media accounts and ad accounts connect in minutes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Measure Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Measure Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.measure.studio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Measure Studio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measure Studio lists 53 MCP tools, including add_slide_to_report, add_tags_to_posts, aggregate_post_stats, create_post_group, create_report, create_report_from_template, get_account_demographics, get_account_geography, get_account_group_stats, get_account_stats, get_ai_summary_values, and get_dashboard_targets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Measure Studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Measure Studio in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Measure Studio MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measure Studio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Measure Studio is developed by Measure Studio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
